notes: Checked: 12 frames over final.mp4 (31.43 s, 1080x1920 vertical, no black frames, captions legible, end card readable, typewriter mid-reveal only); final.text_audit.json ok:true; lint: OK; X text 225 chars, no URL; YT title 63 chars; spelling/grammar clean; trend null; angle is new vs the 2026-10-29 posts. FAIL for: (1) Misleading claims (check 3). The on-screen lines 'HERE THE TEXT IS TYPED, NOT GUESSED' (F7 F13), 'EVERY LETTER EXACTLY AS TYPED' (F13, M-audit) and the end card 'funkbox / EXACT TEXT. EVERY TIME.' present the emblem's Hebrew lettering as funkbox's exact-text feature. But brief.json's note and feedback.json say the emblem was hand-written SVG made in a Claude session outside funkbox, not with funkbox poster tools (F7). M-audit only covers the 13 caption and end-card strings, not the emblem letters, so 'EVERY LETTER EXACTLY AS TYPED' over the emblem does not match its say sentence ('the text audit checked 13 on-screen strings: all exact'). The make.py code card is not funkbox code. The video itself never says funkbox did not draw the emblem; only the YouTube description says so. (2) Content under the owner's name (check 7). The emblem redraws a real organization's emblem (the Tzivos Hashem shield: crenellated banner, 'WE WANT MOSHIACH NOW!' ribbon). The two 'mashups' (mash-b, mash-c) put it on the IDF insignia (Star of David, sword, olive branch), with the large letters for the IDF acronym and 'Army of Hashem for Israel'. That mixes a national military insignia with a religious slogan, which is politically charged, and it uses two real organizations' marks in a product ad. This needs an explicit owner decision, not an automatic post. (3) Minor: feedback.json says funkbox ships no Hebrew font and no slanted lettering. M-commits contradicts that (6af0914 'Hebrew out of the box', e332b6c 'slanted/rotated text', 60d29d5 'text along any path'), so the feedback is out of date. Also, the 'ai' shot shows a low-res, JPEG-artifacted crop of the original emblem cut off at the shield edge. To pass: make the emblem with funkbox's poster tools, or reword the claims so they are only about the video's captions and audit and say on screen that the emblem was drawn outside funkbox. Drop or get the owner's sign-off on the IDF-insignia mashups.
